title: Pure Water Dragon
summary: Bastion Misawa's chemical-bonding Dinosaur strategy, pairing Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, and Duoterion with Souleating Oviraptor to summon Water Dragon and Water Dragon Cluster. Because the base atoms are all Dinosaurs, generic Dinosaur searchers assemble the Bonding pieces and fuel Rank 4 Evolzars.

summary.title: Starters
points: Duoterion discards itself from the hand to search any Bonding Spell or Trap from the Deck, and when Normal or Special Summoned it revives Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, or the discarded Duoterion from the GY.
Souleating Oviraptor searches or sends Duoterion, Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, or Babycerasaurus on Summon, then destroys Babycerasaurus on the field to revive Duoterion from the GY.
Fossil Dig adds any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur from the Deck, including Duoterion, Souleating Oviraptor, Hydrogeddon, or Oxygeddon.

summary.title: Opening: Souleating Oviraptor + Duoterion
steps: Discard Duoterion from the hand to search Bonding - D2O or Bonding - DHO.
Normal Summon Souleating Oviraptor to add Babycerasaurus or Oxygeddon, or destroy a Babycerasaurus to Special Summon a Dinosaur from the Deck and revive Duoterion from the GY.

Trigger the revived Duoterion to Special Summon a second Duoterion, Hydrogeddon, or Oxygeddon from the GY, assembling the Tributes for Bonding - D2O or materials for Evolzar Laggia and Evolzar Dolkka.

summary.title: Water Dragon Cluster & Water Dragon
summary.text: Summoned by Bonding - D2O or Bonding - DHO, Water Dragon Cluster reduces the ATK of all Effect Monsters the opponent currently controls to 0 and stops them from activating their effects for the turn. As a Quick Effect on either turn, Cluster Tributes itself to Special Summon two Water Dragons from the hand or Deck in Defense Position ignoring their summoning conditions. Each Water Dragon sets the ATK of all FIRE and Pyro monsters on the field to 0 and floats into two Hydrogeddons and one Oxygeddon from the GY when destroyed.

summary.title: Control & Extra Deck
points: Evolzar Laggia and Evolzar Dolkka, made from any two Level 4 Dinosaurs (Oviraptor, Hydrogeddon, or Oxygeddon), negate Summons, Spells/Traps, or monster effects.
Number 4: Stealth Kragen, made from two WATER Level 4 Hydrogeddons, turns all face-up monsters on the field into WATER and destroys a WATER monster as a Quick Effect.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy overlays the two Level 8 Water Dragons summoned by Water Dragon Cluster to negate a Spell effect once per turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Bonding - D2O Tributes two Duoterion and one Oxygeddon from the hand and/or field to summon Water Dragon or Water Dragon Cluster from the hand, Deck, or GY, and returns itself from the GY to the hand when either boss goes from the field to the GY.

Bonding - DHO shuffles one Duoterion, one Hydrogeddon, and one Oxygeddon from the hand and/or GY into the Deck to Special Summon Water Dragon Cluster from the hand or GY on either turn, and banishes itself from the GY to search or recover Water Dragon or Cluster.
Bonding - H2O Tributes two Hydrogeddons and one Oxygeddon on the field to summon Water Dragon from the hand, Deck, or GY.

allow.Souleating Oviraptor: Core Level 4 Dinosaur starter: because Duoterion, Hydrogeddon, and Oxygeddon are ALL Dinosaur-Type monsters, Oviraptor searches or sends any of them from your Deck to your hand/GY on Summon, and destroys Babycerasaurus to revive Duoterion (which triggers Duoterion's on-Special-Summon revival of a 2nd Dinosaur!)!
allow.Babycerasaurus: Level 2 Dinosaur that Special Summons Duoterion, Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, or Oviraptor from your Deck when destroyed by Souleating Oviraptor.
allow.Evolzar Laggia: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz summoned using any two Level 4 Dinosaurs (Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, or Souleating Oviraptor!) that detaches 2 materials to negate a Summon or Spell/Trap.
allow.Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz summoned using any two Level 4 Dinosaurs that detaches 1 material to negate monster effects twice per turn.
allow.Number 4: Stealth Kragen: Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz (2 Level 4 WATER monsters: two Hydrogeddons!) that turns monsters into WATER and destroys a WATER monster as a Quick Effect.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Dragon Xyz summoned using the two Level 8 Water Dragons cheated out simultaneously by Water Dragon Cluster to negate Spell activations.

main: Duoterion

Core Level 5 WATER Dinosaur engine: discards itself from your hand to add ANY 'Bonding' Spell/Trap ('Bonding - D2O', 'Bonding - DHO', or 'Bonding - H2O'!) from your Deck to your hand; and when Normal or Special Summoned, targets 1 'Hydrogeddon', 'Oxygeddon', or 'Duoterion' in your GY and Special Summons it!
Water Dragon Cluster

Signature Level 10 WATER Sea Serpent boss (2800 ATK / 2600 DEF): Must be Special Summoned with a 'Bonding' Spell/Trap; when Special Summoned, the ATK of ALL Effect Monsters your opponent currently controls becomes 0, and they CANNOT activate their effects this turn; Quick Effect to Tribute itself and Special Summon TWO 'Water Dragon' from your hand and/or Deck in Defense Position, ignoring their summoning conditions!
Water Dragon

Signature Level 8 WATER Sea Serpent boss (2800 ATK / 2600 DEF): summoned by Bonding Spells/Traps or cheated out in pairs by Water Dragon Cluster; reduces the ATK of all FIRE monsters and Pyro monsters on the field to 0; and when destroyed and sent to the GY, Special Summons 2 'Hydrogeddon' and 1 'Oxygeddon' from your GY!
Hydrogeddon

Level 4 WATER Dinosaur (1600 ATK): when this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY (trivial when Water Dragon Cluster reduces all opposing monsters to 0 ATK!), Special Summons 1 'Hydrogeddon' directly from your Deck!
Oxygeddon
Level 4 WIND Dinosaur (1800 ATK): required Oxygen component for Bonding - H2O, Bonding - D2O, and Bonding - DHO; inflicts 800 burn damage to both players if destroyed by battle with a Pyro monster.
Souleating Oviraptor
Searches or dumps Duoterion, Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, or Babycerasaurus on Normal or Special Summon, and pops Babycerasaurus to revive Duoterion from your GY (which then revives another Dinosaur!).
Babycerasaurus
When destroyed by Oviraptor, Special Summons Level 4 Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, or Oviraptor directly from your Deck.
Bonding - D2O

Core Normal Spell (searched by discarding Duoterion!): tributes 2 'Duoterion' and 1 'Oxygeddon' from your HAND and/or field to Special Summon 'Water Dragon' or 'Water Dragon Cluster' from your hand, Deck, or GY; and if 'Water Dragon' or 'Water Dragon Cluster' is sent from the field to your GY, returns itself from your GY to your hand!
Bonding - H2O
Classic Normal Spell: tributes 2 'Hydrogeddon' and 1 'Oxygeddon' you control to Special Summon 'Water Dragon' from your hand, Deck, or GY.
Fossil Dig
Adds Duoterion, Souleating Oviraptor, Hydrogeddon, or Oxygeddon directly from your Deck to your hand!
Bonding - DHO

Signature Normal Trap (searched by Duoterion!): shuffles 1 'Duoterion', 1 'Hydrogeddon', and 1 'Oxygeddon' from your hand and/or GY into the Deck to Special Summon 'Water Dragon Cluster' from your hand or GY during either player's turn; and banishes itself from your GY to add 'Water Dragon' or 'Water Dragon Cluster' from your Deck or GY to your hand!
extra: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters: Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon, or Souleating Oviraptor) that detaches 2 materials to negate any Summon or Spell/Trap.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters) that detaches 1 material up to twice per turn to negate and destroy monster effects.

Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz (2 Level 4 WATER monsters: two Hydrogeddons!): changes all face-up monsters on the field to WATER, destroys 1 WATER monster on either field as a Quick Effect, and floats into Stealth Kragen Spawn if destroyed!
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 8 monsters: summoned using the two 2800 ATK Water Dragons cheated out simultaneously by Water Dragon Cluster!): negates a Spell Card or effect and attaches it as material!
